title: 4521-ESP-ANC-58-61-PS002
summary:
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles
- Project is a concentrated solar power facility
- Piping installation subcontractor responsible for all pipe lines and components
- All welded metallic piping 3” and larger to be shop fabricated
- Vendor must comply with ASME B 31.3 standards
- The contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
- Field welds for HTF service piping must receive 100% radiographic examination.
- Socketweld joints require visual in-process examination.
- 5% of all welds for other services will be examined using UT with Shearwave and Phased Array modes.
- All pipe spools must be supplied clean without excessive debris or rust.
- Subcontractor is responsible for installing all piping components, supports, and field fabrication.
- Exceptions to pipe specifications are shown on the piping drawings.
